reading_notes: The SYNC line crosses the R10 and R11 vertical leads without junction dots; it does not join this DC reference branch.
R9 is a three-terminal trim: upper end from R10, wiper to V4 base/C7 positive, lower end to V3 cathode.
V3 is a 5.1 V zener with cathode at the R9 lower end and anode at 0 V.
C7 and C5 have their positive plates at the base and emitter nodes respectively.
The first 600 dpi read called the capacitors C3/C4. Separate enlarged labels and the board parts list resolve them as C7/C5; neither C3 nor C4 is in this branch.
The source feed is labelled 12P on the enlarged left-hand view, not 41P.
